ruling: - **R18. One home and one wake per answer; a relay is easy and checked for carelessness.** Owner 16:46 CST Nov 10: "I do think the process of what's being woken, and how to pass words along / relays needs to be vastly improved as the current process is broken/flawed"; 16:54 CST: "too many sessions seem too tapped in to the artifact like they'll be woken for any change to the artifact not just an update to their specific question"; 16:55 CST: "relayed grants need to come in more easily and more intuitively ... we never protect against maliciousness only carelessness/negligence", points 1-4 agreed; 16:57 CST: "agreed yes -- but it should also be known by sessions how to carry my grant so that way it's not like problematic or a cause of pain". 1. Only triage watches the page; a Send wakes triage alone. 2. Each item names who wakes for it: the asker, plus any party it lists. Triage sends exactly those sessions one message (page link, item id, the pick); each reads its answer from the page. 3. Each answer has one home, the page. A question goes only to the page; the chat holds one line, "on the page, item N". A hook moves a question with options from a reply onto the page and leaves that line, so it does not rest on the session remembering. An answer typed in chat goes onto the page at once. 4. Never reply in a page comment thread; the item is rewritten instead (questions-go-to-owner, owner 2026-10-28 02:44 CDT). A hook enforces it over the platform's own suggestion. 5. A relay counts when it carries the owner's exact words, their time, and the one act they cover, in one form every session knows: `Grant: "<exact words>" (owner, <time>) covers <act>`. A guard in the sending session checks the words are in its own feedback log (catches a paraphrase, a widened act or a wrong item); the receiver acts with no page round-trip. A relay in another shape is refused with that form as the remedy. The page route stays. Per guard-guards-mistakes-only, no check assumes an attacker. Evidence (coordinator, 16:49 CST): 9 page comments today each carried two clashing relay instructions. A chat answer reached the page 4-9 min late and the notes hook refused 8 turns meanwhile. Every owner question was sent twice and the copies drift; the H1 grant reached the coordinator only by a chat relay. Cost: one hop through triage before the asker wakes (unmeasured). Home: skill waiting-page; decision relayed-grant-read-from-page, rewritten in place.
